newsitem.title: USA: Boeing seen getting big order from China-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Boeing seen getting big order from China-WSJ.

text.p: Boeing Co is likely to get a big order for a batch of passenger planes from China before a U.S.-China presidential summit in October, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing Chinese government officials.
The paper said in Wednesday's electronic edition China would buy the planes -- as well as other big items made by a variety of U.S. companies -- to set a positive tone for the October 28 summit.
Chinese officials familiar with the matter said China could buy as many as 30 planes -- mostly small ones -- valued at about $2.0 billion.
The officials said China would buy about $3.0 billion in U.S. goods before the summit, according to the paper.
